                                    Dataforeningen by Bielke &#038; Yang                            </h2>
            <p class="hidden sm:block font-sans font-500 -tracking-20 text-black/40 dark:text-white/50 leading-120 text-1">
                <span class="block line-clamp-4">
                    Dataforeningen simply translates as ‘data organisation’ from Norwegian to English, and funnily enough, that’s exactly what the organisation is. Operating nationwide across Norway serving people working in tech, it was looking for a new identity that reflected a shift in who and what it was, and its future aims. Taking on this potentially tricky brief was Oslo-based Bielke &amp; Yang...
